newsitem.title: UK: Kuwait premier has medical treatment in London.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait premier has medical treatment in London.

text.p: Kuwait's Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah was undergoing medical tests in London following surgery on his intestine in Kuwait, a British hospital said on Tuesday.
The London Clinic said in a statement that Skeikh Saad arrived on Monday night and was expected to remain in the hospital for about a week before returning to Kuwait to recuperate.
"His highness expresses his sincere thanks and deep appreciation to the British government for the warm reception and excellent care accorded him on his arrival," the hospital said in a statement.
Sheikh Saad, who has been prime minister and heir apparent since 1978, underwent emergency surgery in Kuwait on Saturday after he fainted from internal bleeding.
